prose.favour: The case in its favour rests mostly on cash flow and the balance sheet: free cash flow is 18.2% of the market value, a solid cash return. Also in its favour: return on capital employed is 21.3%, a strong return on the money in the business; profit grew 18.0% a year on average over three years; and value scores 87 of 100 against the comparison pool. Other areas on this side: what the price asks for the earnings, growth, what the price implies.
prose.against: The case against rests mostly on the balance sheet: profit covers interest costs only 0.1 times; 3 or more is more comfortable. prose.weighing: Weighing them: 6 points in favour and 3 against give more points in favour. The pool score is 63 of 100. The side that carries most weight is cash flow and the balance sheet.
